Title: The Grand Canyon
Content: The Grand Canyon is the `text(second-largest)` canyon on `text(Earth)`. It is located in northern Arizona in the southwestern United States. The Grand Canyon is about `text(5-6 million years)` in age and has exposed rocks that are about `text(1.8 billion years)` old.
The model shows the rock layers in the Grand Canyon.
At the bottom of the Grand Canyon is the Colorado River. This river begins in the Rocky Mountains and flows more than `text(2,300 kilometers)` to the Gulf of California in Mexico.
